facts.fact: 警探坚持自己姓 Smith，无数次纠正上司喊他 Aldente。
facts.anchor: “It’s Smith.” I spin in my chair, pushing my glasses up my nose, and correcting him for the five-hundredth time.

facts.fact: 警长 Cacao 咬定他是 Aldente 家的人，抱怨数字组半年没交进度。
facts.anchor: “No, you’re an Aldente.” He jabs a finger at my head. “You were assigned to the digital division, but I haven’t received a single fucking update.”

facts.fact: 无论他是否脱离犯罪家族，警长永远把他当 Aldente 看待。
facts.anchor: Once an Aldente. Always an Aldente.

facts.fact: 他向警长汇报自己似乎挖到了一名本地杀手。
facts.anchor: “Yes, I think I have uncovered a local hit man. But I’m not sure yet how it will progress.”

facts.fact: 警长曾帮他脱困，作为交换他承诺走正道当警探。
facts.anchor: “The captain helped me out of a tight spot,” I clip back. And he had. In exchange, I promised to walk the straight and narrow.

facts.fact: 他答应在警队干满五年，弥补前五年犯下的无数错误。
facts.anchor: I promised him five years on the force, doing well to offset the last five years I spent making countless mistakes…

facts.fact: 他承认自己已经越界：在暗网建站、配 VPN、建邮箱、收款。
facts.anchor: I had probably already done more than I should. Setting up the website on the dark web, adding a VPN and security measures. Creating an email. Taking payment.

facts.fact: 直到对方要 .carrot 域名，他才确定这是「那种」网站。
facts.anchor: At first I wasn’t sure if the person wanted that type of website, but then they asked for .carrot and I knew.

facts.fact: 付款走加密货币进警局专用账户，网站里还被植入木马以监控访问者。
facts.anchor: The money was sent via crypto to the station’s account used for situations just like this. I put my own trojan horse inside the website I set up, so I would have access to anyone who went to it.

facts.fact: 他看着网站内容纳闷：谁会公开宣传自己是「受雇之刀」？
facts.anchor: Who the fuck advertises being a knife for hire?

facts.fact: 他顺手改了对方的 logo 设计，搜遍硬盘却一无所获。
facts.anchor: I can’t help myself from making a few changes and tweaks. After that, I search the rest of the hard drive…but I don’t find anything.

facts.fact: 照片文件夹里竟然有几千张照片，他震惊地问这是什么人的把戏。
